WEAR_TIME.QUESTION: How long can I wear them?
WEAR_TIME.ANSWER: You can wear one pair for up to [12] hours, depending on your flow. On heavy days you may want to change more often, and for nights choose a heavy-absorbency pair.

WASHING.QUESTION: How do I wash them?
WASHING.ANSWER: After wearing, rinse in cold water until the water runs clear. Then wash by hand or in the machine on a cold cycle [up to 30°C]. Skip fabric softener and bleach. Hang to dry, no tumble dryer.

PAIRS.QUESTION: How many pairs do I need for one cycle?
PAIRS.ANSWER: Usually {{pairs}} pairs are enough for one cycle: some to wear while the others wash and dry. If you have a heavy cycle or can’t wash often, get a few more.

DELIVERY.QUESTION: How does delivery work?
DELIVERY.ANSWER: A courier brings your order anywhere in Georgia, in discreet packaging. You pay when you receive it.

ABOUT.TITLE: The eye of the cyclone
ABOUT.TEXT: At the center of a cyclone there is always calm, no matter what's happening around it. That's why we named our brand Cikloni: we want you to feel that calm too, even on the stormiest days.

DELIVERY.TITLE: Delivery
DELIVERY.INTRO: A courier brings your order anywhere in Georgia. Here’s what delivery costs and how long it takes.

AREAS.TITLE: Where and how fast
AREAS.TBILISI: Any address in Tbilisi [confirm: are the suburbs included?].
AREAS.REGIONS: Other towns and villages across Georgia [confirm any exceptions].
AREAS.NOTE: Times count from when we confirm your order. On weekends and public holidays we [do / don’t] deliver.

HOW.TITLE: How delivery works
HOW.CONFIRM: After you order, we call you to confirm the details.
HOW.COURIER: The courier contacts you before arriving.
HOW.MISSED: If the courier can’t reach you or you’re not there, we’ll agree on a new time [confirm: is a second delivery attempt free?].

PACKAGING.TITLE: Discreet packaging
PACKAGING.TEXT: Your order comes in plain, opaque packaging, so nobody can tell what’s inside [confirm: is the logo shown on the package?].

RETURNS.TITLE: Returns policy
RETURNS.INTRO: We want you to be happy with your order. Underwear is a hygiene product, so we can only accept returns under a few conditions.

CONDITIONS.TITLE: What can be returned
CONDITIONS.UNOPENED: The item is unopened and in its original packaging.
CONDITIONS.UNUSED: The item hasn’t been tried on, washed or worn.
CONDITIONS.WINDOW: You ask for the return within [14] days of receiving your order.
CONDITIONS.HYGIENE: For hygiene reasons, we can’t take back underwear that has been opened or tried on. This keeps every customer safe.

WRONG_ITEM.TITLE: If something went wrong
WRONG_ITEM.TEXT: If you got the wrong size or color, or the item is damaged, message us within [3] days with a photo. We’ll replace it or refund you, even if you’ve already opened the package.

HOW.TITLE: How to request a return

STEPS.CONTACT: Contact us by phone, email or Instagram and send us your order number.
STEPS.DETAILS: Tell us which item you’d like to return and why.
STEPS.HANDOVER: We’ll agree on how you hand the item back [a courier picks it up / you send it].
STEPS.REFUND: Once we receive and check the item, we refund you.

HOW.SHIPPING: Return shipping is paid by [the customer / Cikloni]. If the mistake was ours, we always cover it.

REFUND.TITLE: Refunds
REFUND.TEXT: We refund you [by bank transfer to your account] within [5] business days of receiving the item.
REFUND.DELIVERY_FEE: The original delivery fee [is / isn’t] refunded, unless the mistake was ours.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: We only need your data to get your order to you. Here’s a simple explanation of what we collect and why.

WHO.TITLE: Who we are
WHO.TEXT: The Cikloni online shop is run by [company or sole trader name], ID code [code], address: [legal address]. We are responsible for your data.

COLLECT.TITLE: What we collect
COLLECT.INTRO: When you place an order, you share:
COLLECT.NAME: your first and last name
COLLECT.EMAIL: your email, if you give it
COLLECT.ADDRESS: your delivery address: city or village, street, building and apartment
COLLECT.NOTES: a note for the courier, if you write one
COLLECT.ORDER: We also keep the order details: what you bought, the price and when you ordered.
COLLECT.NO_CARDS: We don’t collect or store card details.

WHY.TITLE: Why we need it
WHY.CONFIRM: To confirm your order and contact you about it.
WHY.DELIVER: To deliver your order: we pass your name, phone and address to the courier.
WHY.SUPPORT: To handle returns or any other problem.
WHY.LAW: To keep our accounts and meet other legal obligations.
WHY.NO_SELLING: We never sell your data or use it for advertising. We only send you news if you subscribe yourself.

STORAGE.TITLE: Where it’s stored
STORAGE.TEXT: Your data is kept in a secure database provided by Supabase (servers in [region, e.g. the EU]). Only our team can access it.
STORAGE.SHARED: We share what’s needed for delivery with our courier company, [courier name]. We don’t pass your data to anyone else unless the law requires it.
STORAGE.BROWSER: Your cart and language choice are saved only in your browser and are never sent to us. We don’t use advertising cookies.

RETENTION.TITLE: How long we keep it
RETENTION.TEXT: We keep order data for [X years] from the order date, because we need it for accounting and returns. After that, we delete it.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Your rights and deleting your data
RIGHTS.TEXT: At any time you can ask what data we hold about you, and ask us to correct or delete it.
RIGHTS.HOW: Just contact us with the phone number you used to order. We’ll handle your request within [10] days. If the law requires us to keep some of it, we’ll tell you what and for how long.
RIGHTS.COMPLAINT: If you think we’re handling your data wrongly, you can contact the Personal Data Protection Service of Georgia.

TERMS.TITLE: Terms of sale
TERMS.INTRO: These terms apply to every order placed on cikloni.ge. By sending an order, you agree to them.

SELLER.TITLE: Seller
SELLER.TEXT: [Company or sole trader name], ID code [code], address: [legal address].

PRICES.TITLE: Prices
PRICES.GEL: All prices are in Georgian lari (₾).
PRICES.DELIVERY: The delivery fee is added separately and shown on the checkout page before you confirm.
PRICES.FIXED: Your order’s price is fixed when you send it. If a price changes later, your order isn’t affected.

ORDER.TITLE: Orders and confirmation
ORDER.NUMBER: You see your order number as soon as you send the order.
ORDER.CONFIRMATION: Our team calls you to confirm the order. The order is final once it’s confirmed.
ORDER.UNAVAILABLE: If an item is out of stock or a price was shown by mistake, we’ll tell you and you can change or cancel your order.
ORDER.CANCEL: You can cancel your order for free [before it’s handed to the courier].

CHANGES.TEXT: We may update these terms from time to time. Your order is covered by the terms that applied when you sent it.
CHANGES.LAW: These terms are governed by the laws of Georgia.

CONTACT.INTRO: Have a question about an order, sizing or care? Message or call us, we’re happy to help.
